test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who are the main beneficiaries of the PM-Kisan Maandhan Yojana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Marginal farmers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The PM-Kisan Maandhan Yojana is a pension scheme introduced by the Government of India to provide social security to **marginal farmers and small farmers.**
 
• It was launched on **12 September 2019** in Jharkhand by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, aiming to ensure financial stability for farmers in their old age.
 
• The scheme provides a **monthly pension of Rs. 3000** after the age of 60 to farmers who enroll and contribute during their working years.
 
• Farmers within the **age group of 18 to 40 years** with cultivable land of up to 2 hectares are eligible to apply for the scheme.
 
• The contributions to the pension fund vary between Rs. 55 and Rs. 200 per month, depending on the age of entry, and the government matches the contribution.
 
• The scheme is managed by the Life Insurance Corporation (LIC) of India, which ensures the disbursement of pensions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fishermen**

 
 
• While fishermen are not the primary beneficiaries of PM-Kisan Maandhan Yojana, they are supported under other schemes such as the **Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)**.
 
• PMMSY aims to enhance fish production, create employment, and improve infrastructure for fishermen and aquaculture farmers.
 
• It supports the development of cold storage chains, fish markets, and modernized fishing techniques.
 
 
 
• **Women SHGs (Self-Help Groups)**
 
 
• Women SHGs are not the target group for PM-Kisan Maandhan Yojana; however, they are beneficiaries under schemes like **Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)**.
 
• DAY-NRLM promotes women's empowerment by providing financial assistance, skill development, and livelihood opportunities through SHGs.
 
• It focuses on poverty alleviation by enabling SHG members to access credit, market linkages, and entrepreneurship opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Retired Civil Servants**
 
 
• Retired civil servants are not eligible for the PM-Kisan Maandhan Yojana as they typically receive pensions through government pension schemes.
 
• They are supported under the **National Pension System (NPS)**, which ensures old-age income security for government employees and other subscribers.
